edition: Health news digest – Thursday, 19 November 2026 – Afternoon edition

items.title: GOLD 2027 Report and Pocket Guide released
items.publisher: Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease (GOLD)
items.summary: GOLD published its 2027 COPD strategy report and pocket guide on World COPD Day. The update places pulmonary rehabilitation and non-drug care at the core of management, recommends a LAMA as initial therapy for group A, and revises definitions of early, mild, young-onset and pre-COPD.

items.title: Anaphylaxis Reporting Varies Across Respiratory Biologics In FAERS
items.summary: A retrospective FAERS analysis presented at ACAAI 2026 compared anaphylaxis reporting for 7 respiratory biologics from October 2020 to March 2026. Omalizumab had the highest anaphylaxis reporting proportion and dupilumab the lowest among established agents.

items.title: Regional perspectives on air quality and health: WHO Western Pacific Region – technical brief
items.summary: WHO released regional technical briefs on air pollution and health, including one for the Western Pacific, where exposure contributes to more than 2 million deaths. The brief notes gaps between national standards and WHO guideline levels and calls for stronger monitoring, clean household energy and cross-border cooperation.

items.title: Lung Cancer Survival Rate Climbs to 31%, Although Screening Gaps Persist
items.summary: The American Lung Association's latest report says US lung cancer survival has risen to 31% but screening uptake remains low. The ALA is urging Congress to pass the Clinical Trial Modernization Act to widen trial access.
